nodes.summary: Let $F_n$ be the free group on the basis $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, and for $w \in F_n$ let $|w|$ be the length of the reduced word representing $w$. The norm of an automorphism $\alpha$ of $F_n$ is $\|\alpha\| = \max(|\alpha(x_0)|, \dots, |\alpha(x_{n-1})|)$, taken to be $0$ when $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Norm of an automorphism of a free group

nodes.summary: For every natural number $r$ there is a computable function $f$ which takes the images of the $r$ free generators of the free group $F_r$, each encoded as a word in the generators and their inverses, and returns a Boolean, such that whenever the endomorphism $\varphi$ of $F_r$ sending each generator to its image is bijective, $f$ returns true exactly when $\varphi(w) = w$ for some $w \neq 1$ in $F_r$.
nodes.title: Fixed points of free group automorphisms are decidable (Kourovka 10.25)

nodes.summary: The assertion that for every natural number $r$ there is a computable function $f$ which takes the images of the $r$ free generators of the free group $F_r$, each encoded as a word in the generators and their inverses, and returns a Boolean, such that whenever the endomorphism $\varphi$ of $F_r$ sending each generator to its image is bijective, $f$ returns true exactly when $\varphi(w) = w$ for some $w \neq 1$ in…
nodes.title: Decidability of fixed points of free group automorphisms (Kourovka 10.25)

nodes.summary: Let $F_r$ be the free group on generators $e_0, \dots, e_{r-1}$. Given, for each $i < r$, a word $u_i$ in these generators and their inverses, this is the endomorphism of $F_r$ sending each $e_i$ to the element of $F_r$ represented by $u_i$.
nodes.title: Endomorphism of a free group given by generator images

nodes.summary: For every $n$ there is a computable function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every automorphism $\alpha$ of the free group $F_n$ on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, the fixed subgroup $\mathrm{Fix}(\alpha)$ has a finite free basis all of whose elements have reduced word length at most $f(\|\alpha\|)$, where $\|\alpha\|$ is the maximum of the reduced word lengths of $\alpha(x_0), \dots, \alpha(x_{n-1})$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.23 holds for each rank

nodes.summary: For every $n$ there is a computable function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every automorphism $\alpha$ of the free group $F_n$ on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, the fixed subgroup $\mathrm{Fix}(\alpha)$ has a finite free basis all of whose elements have reduced word length at most $f(\|\alpha\|)$, where $\|\alpha\|$ is the maximum of the reduced word lengths of $\alpha(x_0), \dots, \alpha(x_{n-1})$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.23, rank-dependent form

nodes.summary: There is no computable function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n$ and every automorphism $\alpha$ of the free group $F_n$ on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, the fixed subgroup $\mathrm{Fix}(\alpha)$ has a finite free basis all of whose elements have reduced word length at most $f(\|\alpha\|)$, where $\|\alpha\|$ is the maximum of the reduced word lengths of $\alpha(x_0), \dots, \alpha(x_{n-1})$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.23 fails uniformly in the rank

nodes.summary: There is a computable function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n$ and every automorphism $\alpha$ of the free group $F_n$ on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, the fixed subgroup $\mathrm{Fix}(\alpha)$ has a finite free basis all of whose elements have reduced word length at most $f(\|\alpha\|)$, where $\|\alpha\|$ is the maximum of the reduced word lengths of $\alpha(x_0), \dots, \alpha(x_{n-1})$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.23, rank-uniform form

nodes.summary: For an automorphism $\alpha$ of the free group $F_n$ on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, the fixed subgroup of $\alpha$ is the subgroup $\mathrm{Fix}(\alpha) = \{x \in F_n \mid \alpha(x) = x\}$ of $F_n$.
nodes.title: Fixed subgroup of a free group automorphism

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be an automorphism of the free group $F_n$ on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, let $|w|$ be the length of the reduced word representing $w \in F_n$, and let $L$ be a natural number. The fixed subgroup $\mathrm{Fix}(\alpha)$ has a short free basis with bound $L$ when, for some $k \ge 0$, it has a free basis $y_1, \dots, y_k$ with $|y_i| \le L$ for every $i$.
nodes.title: Fixed subgroups with a short free basis

nodes.summary: A word of rank $r$ is a finite list of pairs $(i, \varepsilon)$ with $i < r$ and $\varepsilon$ a Boolean. It encodes the element of the free group $F_r$ of rank $r$ that is the product of its letters, where $(i, \mathrm{true})$ stands for the $i$-th free generator and $(i, \mathrm{false})$ for its inverse.
nodes.title: Encoded words in a free group of finite rank
